triage.summary: Lucía Martín says her company has changed banks and asks Alex to send future payments to a new IBAN, confirming the records are updated. She says the old account closes tomorrow.
triage.risk_reason: The sender requests a change to payment bank details and uses a one-day deadline, which could be a fraudulent payment-redirection attempt.
